page.title: My profile
page.subtitle: Manage your ESN information and account security.

identity.title: Identity
identity.subtitle: Your first and last name appear in your personal space.
identity.emailHint: Email changes are confirmed with a code sent to the new address.
identity.timezoneHint: It decides which day “tomorrow” is when you ask {{copilot}} for a follow-up, and what time your routines run.
identity.timezoneDetectedHint: Proposed from your browser ({{timezone}}) — save to confirm it, or pick another one. Until something is saved, the reference time zone is Europe/Paris.
identity.signatureHint: It is added at the bottom of the drafts {{brand}} prepares. Left empty, your inbox's own signature applies.

businessRole.label: Business role
businessRole.error: The business role could not be saved
businessRole.hint: Your role orders your My day page: the same blocks, in the order of your job.

identity.securityNote: Your password and two-factor authentication are managed in

businessUnits.title: My scopes
businessUnits.subtitle: The business units, agencies or teams you belong to. Upcoming analyses take them into account: an account's verdict cites your scope.
businessUnits.restricted: Your access is limited to your scopes: to join another one, request access from its lead.
businessUnits.error: Could not read your workspace's scopes. Try again in a moment.
businessUnits.empty: Your workspace has not defined any scope yet.

territory.title: Territory model
territory.subtitle: The 7 axes your territory can carry. Three are already answers on your profile, editable here; the other four don't exist yet in the product — named, never guessed.

agenciesRegionsCountries.title: Agencies, regions and countries
agenciesRegionsCountries.hint: Two distinct answers: where your firm is based (agencies/offices), and the zones it targets (regions, countries, national, international — still one list, not three separate axes).

localSectors.title: Local sectors
localSectors.reason: no sector is crossed with a zone yet — targeted sectors remain national.

reservedAccounts.title: Reserved accounts and group-accessible accounts
reservedAccounts.reason: no cross-workspace account reservation exists yet.

territoryRules.title: Territory rules
territoryRules.reason: no territory rules engine exists yet.

exclusiveOrShared.title: Exclusive or shared scope
exclusiveOrShared.reason: depends on reserved accounts, which don't exist yet.

email.dialogDescription: To confirm the new address, we will send it a 6-character code. This change applies to your {{brand}} account.
email.codeSentHint: Code sent to {{email}}. Also check your spam folder.

shared.subtitleEditable: Shared with the whole team — your changes apply to every member.
shared.subtitleLocked: Company fields are shared by the team and editable by the owner or an admin.
shared.lockedField: Company field — editable by the owner or an admin.

correction.dialogTitle: Report a wrong piece of information
correction.dialogDescription: Nothing is changed: your request goes straight to your workspace's administrators.
correction.successTitle: Report sent to your workspace's administrators.
correction.errorBody: Could not send your report. Try again.

personal.title: My personal preferences
personal.hint: Your main sales blocker stays personal: it only affects your own analyses.

impactedAccounts.notice_one: {{count}} account was analysed with an ESN profile older than today's.
impactedAccounts.notice_other: {{count}} accounts were analysed with an ESN profile older than today's.

confirmAnswer.error: Confirmation failed. Try again in a moment.

marketMemory.title: Your company in market observations
marketMemory.paths: {{paths}} career paths observed around your company.

matchedOn.name: Matched to “{{company}}” by name. If that is not your company, these observations are not about it.
matchedOn.alias: Matched to “{{company}}” through a recorded equivalence. If that is not your company, these observations are not about it.

marketMemory.insufficient: Your company is not sufficiently covered in our observations.
marketMemory.undeclared: Fill in your company name above: without it, {{brand}} has nothing to observe.
marketMemory.unavailable: These observations could not be read. Try again in a moment.

stage.guidedModeLink: Revisit this questionnaire in guided mode, with {{copilot}}'s help
stage.guidedModeError: The request could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage your password and account access.
security.passwordDescription: You will receive an email to reset it.

toast.resetSent: We have sent you a reset link by email.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deleting your account is permanent and results in the loss of all your data.
danger.rowDescription: This action erases all your data - accounts, contacts, action plans.
danger.confirmPrompt: Are you sure? This action is irreversible.

section.title: {{brand}} profile
section.rowDescAvailable: Profile summary, analysis personalization and tailored coaching.

header.title: Your {{brand}} profile
header.subtitle: What the agents use to personalize your analyses.

failure.model_error: The model did not return a usable profile.
failure.model_unreachable: The analysis service did not respond.
failure.persist_failed: The profile was produced but could not be saved.

emptyState.description: No profile generated yet. Launch a generation to personalize the other agents' analyses.

regenerate.title: Regenerate your AI context?
regenerate.description: {{brand}} will re-run the analysis of your profile and replace the current context. The current version stays available and can be restored from “Versions”.
regenerate.toastError: Couldn't start the regeneration. Try again in a moment.

regenerateSection.title: Regenerate this section?
regenerateSection.description: {{brand}} will re-run the analysis of your profile, but only replaces this section — the rest of your AI context stays untouched.
regenerateSection.toastError: Couldn't regenerate this section. Try again in a moment.

versions.title: Versions
versions.subtitle: History of your AI context. Restore a previous version at any time.
versions.confirmDescription: This version will replace your current AI context. The action is reversible: the current version stays in the history.
versions.toastError: Couldn't restore. Try again in a moment.

impactedAccounts.title: Accounts affected by this change
impactedAccounts.description_one: {{count}} account was analysed with an earlier profile.
impactedAccounts.description_other: {{count}} accounts were analysed with an earlier profile.
impactedAccounts.hint: Nothing replays on its own: open a file to be offered its recalculation, at its cost.

suggestions.title: Launch your first analysis
suggestions.subtitle: Click a suggestion below to launch your first analysis and continue.

targetPersonas.title: Roles you target
targetPersonas.description: Import your target job titles with their decision-maker level: they order an account's contacts (never filter them) and the reason shows on each contact.
targetPersonas.format: Columns: category, title, decision level (1 to 4). csv file (; or , separator) or xlsx.
targetPersonas.empty: No target role imported: contact order is unchanged.
targetPersonas.replaceHint: A new import replaces all target roles.
targetPersonas.fed: {{count}} level 1-2 title(s) added to your decision-maker contacts.

missingColumn.title: Column "title" not found: nothing was imported.
missingColumn.level: Column "decision level" not found: nothing was imported.

targetPersonas.locked: Only a workspace manager can import target roles.

offerPortfolio.title: Offer portfolio
offerPortfolio.subtitle: What your company sells, to which sectors, on which sites — and the wording it uses.
offerPortfolio.locked: Only a team manager can change the company portfolio.

understood.title: What {{brand}} understood
understood.sentence: You are a {{companyType}}, and you mainly sell: {{domains}}.
understood.unknown: No offer domain selected yet: {{brand}} cannot say what you sell. Complete your offer in the profile.
understood.notConfigured: Nothing is configured here yet — what you see below is empty, not a default choice.
understood.lockedReason: Reserved to workspace admins — you can report an error.

sectors.title: Target application sectors
sectors.hint: The market your work is delivered into. Used to match projects and your consultants' experience — empty means "no declared targeting", never "all".

site.title: Site policy
site.hint: A preference, not a rule: a site below the threshold is still surfaced when it carries a strong signal.

lexicon.movedHint: Forbidden words and the name your team gives each product object now live on their own screen — a setting is edited in one place only.

soldSeniority.title: Levels you place
soldSeniority.hint: Tick the consultant levels the company sells. When left blank, job offers are not compared with your offer.

feedbackReuse.label: Share the verdict on my first analyses (right, partial, wrong, missing) with {{brand}}'s product review
feedbackReuse.hint: Off by default. Only the verdict is shared — never the account name nor the text of a note. Applies to verdicts given from now on: those already given stay private to your workspace.

placedRoles.title: Roles you place
placedRoles.label: Roles you place
placedRoles.description: The roles your company actually places (developer, data, cloud…). A job posting outside these roles is ranked after the others in “Why now”. Same answer as the profile complement question: changing it here changes it there.
placedRoles.empty: No role declared: job postings stay “not assessable”, never penalised.
placedRoles.locked: Only a workspace admin can change the placed roles.
placedRoles.error: The placed roles could not be saved.

inferred.title: Inferred from your context
inferred.whenNotDeclared: Until you declare any, these roles widen your hiring signals and rank first — they never remove one. Confirm or remove them.
inferred.whenDeclared: Your declared roles prevail: these stay suggestions until you confirm them.
inferred.questionBody: Nothing in your context (profile, offer, talent pool, missions) lets us infer it yet, and we don't guess. Tell us above: your hiring signals will follow your roles.
inferred.dismissed: Role removed: it won't come back.
inferred.full: Six declared roles at most: remove one to confirm this one.

framing.subtitle: You can adjust your context without starting over. Fix a theme, then read what {{copilot}} infers from it.

maturity.title: Your sales maturity
maturity.subtitle: Computed from your answers and your activity. An axis that cannot be assessed leaves the calculation: it is not counted as zero.

context.title: What {{copilot}} knows about your firm
context.subtitle: The detail behind the framing. Each line can be corrected here, without redoing the questionnaire.

framing.title: Your working profile
